proved_scope: absolute reciprocal-mass bound for contributing primes p>sqrt(2n)
survivor_assessment: The large-prime tail is proved but insufficient. The only closure-oriented survivor is an unstated pointwise many-base rigidity inequality; EGRS rules out pairwise incompatibility, CRT gives full-period independence, and Fourier l1 tensorization grows. No precise all-parameter lemma survived strongly enough to earn an automatic longer round.
recommended_next_action: Switch to another fresh problem. Reopen #377 only if a precise growing-many-base inequality or an independently audited arbitrary-finite-base construction becomes available.
